pr_body:
Add support for some of the stream control procedures for the unicast server. 

This should add support for all server procedures except for configuring the ASE first time around (i.e. the server can only reconfigure an endpoint). This is a limitation of the current stream control API. 

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/44400

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Unicast server stream control
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The unicast server is currently not able to control the states of the ASEs, as all the `bt_audio_stream_` functions that handle such changes are guarded with 

```c
	role = stream->conn->role;
	if (role != BT_HCI_ROLE_CENTRAL) {
		BT_DBG("Invalid conn role: %u, shall be central", role);
		return -EINVAL;
	}
```

and thus currently only works for the client. 

The unicast server is the owner of the ASEs, and should be able to control the ASEs. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Either create a new set of API functions for the unicast server to set ASE states and values, or use the existing `bt_audio_stream_` functions. The latter of which will require a connection to be established first, to perform a role check. 

We need to figure out how much the unicast server can do while disconnected, e.g. it should definitely not be able to go into a streaming state, but what about configuring codecs and QoS? 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
N/A

Why would keeping the state trigger notifications?

This is just copied code, but `ascs_ep_set_state` will call `ase_status_changed` to send notifications. The reason we do this is that setting metadata does not change the endpoint state, but the notification contains the metadata, so this is a way to use existing functionality to trigger the notification to send metadata. 

I could implement a `ascs_ep_metadata_changed` function to add some more readability to it if you like
